title: ‘He was pregnant, delivered 6 MPs’: After ‘ga**u’ row, Sanjay Raut’s fresh attack on Shinde as rebels ready to jump ship
description: Six Shiv Sena (UBT) MPs are expected to join the Eknath Shinde-led Shiv Sena, prompting a sharp reaction from Sanjay Raut, who mocked the Maharashtra deputy CM.
